what: Four blobs float behind the cell, merging and splitting (joined with smin .25, with edges rippling at wave 4.2 and speed 2.8). When the cell enters the screen, the blobs emerge from the center at radius 0 and scatter, growing over 1.6s. The cursor blob follows the mouse 5% per frame and pushes the other blobs away. In the accent type, a three-color gradient blob (center → edge .58x) paints even the background. In the soft type, only single-color flat blobs sit on a transparent background.

options.look: accent (default — three-color gradient blob, background filled) | soft (single-color flat blob, transparent background)
options.scale: Bubble size multiplier, default accent .7 · soft .38
options.cursor: Cursor bubble diameter base (px, soft type) — 0 means no cursor bubble. The accent type uses .044 of screen width
options.center: If 1, cursor bubbles come out near the center of the cell
options.--fx-blob-soft: Droplet color for the soft type, default --kf-ink
options.--fx-blob-bg: Background color of accent type, default --kf-bg

use: <section data-fx="blob-field" data-fx-blob-field="look: soft; scale: .8; cursor: 60; opacity: 1">…</section>
note: Bubble positions are random on every open (same as the original). The canvas sits behind the cells (z -1) and each cell creates a stacking context with isolation. On touch devices the cursor bubbles are turned off
